heading: Rules and regulations when cooperating with military departments

tree.heading: Joint regulations
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of Commerce shall jointly prescribe regulations—

children.text: governing the duties to be performed by the Administration in time of war; and
providing for the cooperation of the Administration with the military departments in time of peace in preparation for its duties in time of war.

tree.heading: Approval
tree.text: Regulations under subsection (a) shall not be effective unless approved by each of those Secretaries.

tree.heading: Communications
tree.text: Regulations under subsection (a) may provide procedures for making reports and communications between a military department and the Administration.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 858 of this title prior to repeal by Pub. L. 107–372.
